title: Jacobi-Zariski sequence for a quotient of a smooth algebra
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $H_1(L_{B/A})=0$ and $\Omega_{B/A}$ is a projective $B$-module (e.g. $A\to B$ smooth) [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], let $\mathfrak a\subseteq B$ be an ideal and $C=B/\mathfrak a$, an $A$-algebra via $A\to B\to C$. Then there is an exact sequence of $C$-modules $$0\to H_1(L_{C/A})\to\mathfrak a/\mathfrak a^2\xrightarrow{\ \delta\ }C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}\xrightarrow{\ w\ }\Omega_{C/A}\to0,$$ where $\delta(a\bmod\mathfrak a^2)=1\otimes\mathrm da$ and $w(c\otimes\mathrm db)=c\,\mathrm d\bar b$ ($\bar b$ the class of $b$ in $C$; $\Omega$ and $\mathrm d$ as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00S2 (lemma-exact-sequence-NL, Jacobi-Zariski sequence, line 35412) for A -> B -> C, including its final assertion (if Tor_1^B(Omega_{B/A},C) = Tor_2^B(Omega_{B/A},C) = 0 then H_1(NL_{B/A} (x)_B C) = H_1(L_{B/A}) (x)_B C), with Lemma Tag 07BP (lemma-NL-surjection, line 35506: H_1(L_{C/B}) = a/a^2, Omega_{C/B} = 0) and Lemma Tag 00RU (lemma-differential-seq, line 34103) for the maps delta and w; this is the sequence used in More on Algebra, proof of Lemma 07M7 ('note that H_1(L_{B/A}) = 0 and that Omega_{B/A} is finite projective, in particular flat so the Tor group vanishes')
